reviewer: Claude review agent reviewer-desc, independent of the extractor; no human review claimed
scope: Independent review of issue #88 description batch a: 59 records (49 mRNABench linear-probe pipelines, 8 named prediction methods, DeepAffinity, DeepDTA) and 62 batch records (59 metadata-correction claims, 3 sources). Store diff compared with origin/main; method and model descriptions read against their sources; the mRNABench rows spot-checked against Appendix A; new-source licences checked against Europe PMC. See docs/reviews/2026-10-11-description-batches-a-e.md.
limitations: Automated review by a separate Claude agent; not human scientific review.
Descriptions were checked against cited passages and abstracts; large groups were spot-checked rather than read row by row, except where stated in the scope.
Some Europe PMC responses no longer reproduce their pinned bytes; they are listed in changes.md and their hash_scope says these responses are not byte-stable.

errors.message: Optional: checkpoint names printed with an en dash in the source table are written with a hyphen in the mRNABench descriptions. Record names unchanged.
